## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated; a bug fix starts with a failing test
- [ ] New detection behaviour has a fixture in `tests/Fixtures`
- [ ] `composer check` passes (Pint, PHPStan, Pest)
- [ ] No change to `src/Contracts`, the config shape, the baseline format or command options without an ADR in `docs/adr`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated if users will notice the change
